== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Captain Needa: the entry in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' (November 1998), PDF page 32, cropped at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Image for [[Captain Needa (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: Decipher, [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0] (November 1998), PDF page 32, entry Captain Needa. Wiki copy: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]].
